subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

My friend is not stubborn with regard to opinions; in fact, she is ________ (intransigent).
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **subservient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"intransigent"** means refusing to change one's views or to agree about something. (अडिग)

 
 
• **Example: **The intransigent leader refused to compromise on any of the party's policies.
 
 
 
• **"Subservient"** refers to being prepared to obey others unquestioningly; submissive. (अधीन)
 
 
• **Example: **The subservient employee followed every order without question.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'intransigent' is 'subservient'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **subservient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pertinacious** (हठी): Holding firmly to an opinion or a course of action.

 
 
• **Example:** Her pertinacious attitude helped her achieve her goals despite many obstacles.
 
 
 
• **Obstinate** (हठी): Stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action.
 
 
• **Example:** The obstinate child refused to eat his vegetables.
 
 
 
• **Tenacious** (दृढ़): Tending to keep a firm hold of something; clinging or adhering closely.
 
 
• **Example:** Her tenacious grip on the rope saved her from falling.
